senses.gloss: (read אַנְגִּירָא?) pr. n. pl. Ancyra, a city of Galatia in Asia Minor.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 46b">B. Mets. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>דינר אניאקא ואנגרא</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>אנקא ואניגרא</he>, Var. <cite ref="N00663"><he>נְיָיקָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="A02226"><he>אַנְיָיקָא</he></cite>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note, Ar. Compl. ed. Koh. s. v. <cite ref="A02104"><he>אנגרא</he></cite>) the Bithynian and the Ancyrean Denars, one of which was repealed by the central Government, the other by the local authority. V. <cite ref="A02219"><he>אֵנְיָאקָא</he></cite>. [Ancyra prob. of Semitic origin, v. <cite ref="N00620"><he>נִיגְרָא</he></cite> a. <cite ref="A02221"><he>אַנִּיגְרָא</he></cite>.]
